summary: Meta-Magic: the caster's next Enchantment returns with its bearer after respawning until otherwise removed, keeping remaining uses.

effects.subject: caster
effects.note: Stated before another incantation; affects the next ability cast by the same caster. The Enchantment then returns after respawn until otherwise removed (E1).

requirements.note: E1 speaks of the Enchantment returning, so the next ability must be an Enchantment.

clarifications.text: The Enchantment keeps returning after each respawn until it is removed some other way.
Persistent is Meta-Magic: used before another incantation, it affects the next ability cast by the same caster.
It does not make an Enchantment already on a player Persistent retroactively.
Persistent Enchantments with limited uses (Mass Healing, Corrosive Mist, etc.) keep the number of uses they had left.
Persistent Magic Armor behaves like normal armor: repaired on respawn, but keeps prior damage if the bearer returns to life another way (e.g. Resurrect).

open_questions: E1 says the Enchantment returns 'with the user'; read as whoever wears the Enchantment (which may be another player), not only the caster of Persistent.
